t1.descripcion:
Phrases for asking for directions:

🔹 COMMON QUESTIONS:
• ¿Dónde está...? = Where is...?
• ¿Cómo llego a...? = How do I get to...?
• ¿Hay un/una... por aquí? = Is there a... around here?
• ¿Está lejos? = Is it far?
• ¿Cuánto tiempo se tarda? = How long does it take?
• ¿Puede ayudarme? = Can you help me?
• ¿Va por aquí? = Is it this way?
• ¿A qué distancia está? = How far is it?
• ¿Qué autobús/ metro puedo coger? = Which bus/metro can I take?

🔹 EXAMPLES:
• ¿Dónde está la farmacia? (Where is the pharmacy?)
• ¿Cómo llego al museo? (How do I get to the museum?)
• ¿Hay un restaurante por aquí? (Is there a restaurant around here?)
• ¿Está lejos la estación? (Is the station far?)
• ¿Cuánto se tarda en coche? (How long does it take by car?)

📌 CULTURAL NOTE:
In Spanish-speaking countries, it is normal to ask strangers for directions, especially in small shops or on the street. People are usually very kind and willing to help.

t4.descripcion:
Useful landmarks for giving directions:

🔹 COMMON PLACES:
• la plaza = the square
• la iglesia = the church
• la catedral = the cathedral
• el parque = the park
• el mercado = the market
• la estación de tren = the train station
• la estación de metro = the metro station
• la parada de autobús = the bus stop
• el semáforo = the traffic light
• la rotonda / glorieta = the roundabout
• el puente = the bridge
• la fuente = the fountain
• el ayuntamiento = the town hall
• el hospital = the hospital
• la farmacia = the pharmacy
• el supermercado = the supermarket

🔹 EXAMPLES WITH LANDMARKS:
• Sigue recto hasta la plaza.
• Gira a la izquierda en la iglesia.
• Está detrás del mercado.
• El banco está al lado de la farmacia, enfrente del supermercado.

📌 ADDITIONAL VOCABULARY:
• a la altura de = at the level of
• pasando el = past the
• antes del = before the
• después del = after the
• justo en = right at

📌 EXAMPLES:
• Gira a la izquierda en la iglesia.
• Está detrás del mercado.
• El banco está al lado de la farmacia.
ejemplos: Gira a la izquierda en la iglesia.
El banco está al lado de la farmacia.

t2.descripcion:
Phrases for giving directions:

🔹 MOVEMENT AND DIRECTION:
• sigue todo recto = go straight
• gira a la izquierda = turn left
• gira a la derecha = turn right
• toma la primera calle a la derecha = take the first street on the right
• toma la segunda calle a la izquierda = take the second street on the left
• cruza la calle = cross the street
• continúa = continue
• pasa de largo = go past
• da la vuelta = turn around

🔹 LOCATION OF THE DESTINATION:
• está a la izquierda = it's on the left
• está a la derecha = it's on the right
• está al final de la calle = it's at the end of the street
• está en la esquina = it's on the corner
• está a la vuelta de la esquina = it's around the corner
• está enfrente de = it's opposite
• está detrás de = it's behind
• está al lado de = it's next to
• está entre... y... = it's between... and...

🔹 DISTANCE:
• está a dos cuadras = it's two blocks away
• está a cinco minutos a pie = it's a five-minute walk
• está a diez minutos en coche = it's a ten-minute drive
• está muy cerca = it's very close
• está bastante lejos = it's quite far

📌 EXAMPLES:
• Sigue recto dos cuadras.
• Gira a la izquierda en el semáforo.
• Está a la derecha, al lado del banco.
• Toma la primera calle y luego sigue recto.
ejemplos: Sigue recto y gira a la izquierda.
Está al final de la calle.
Toma la segunda calle a la derecha.

t3.descripcion:
Useful expressions:

🔹 DISTANCE:
• está muy cerca = it's very close
• está bastante lejos = it's quite far
• está a cinco minutos a pie = it's a five-minute walk
• está a diez minutos en coche = it's a ten-minute drive
• está a dos manzanas / cuadras = it's two blocks away
• está a 500 metros = it's 500 meters away
• no está lejos = it's not far
• puedes ir andando = you can walk there

🔹 TIME:
• tarda unos quince minutos = it takes about fifteen minutes
• se tarda media hora en autobús = it takes half an hour by bus
• en coche tardas diez minutos = by car it takes ten minutes
• puedes ir andando en cinco minutos = you can walk there in five minutes
• es mejor ir en autobús = it's better to go by bus
• el tráfico puede ser malo = traffic can be bad

🔹 DISTANCE AND TIME QUESTIONS:
• ¿A cuánto queda? = How far is it?
• ¿Cuánto se tarda? = How long does it take?
• ¿Puedo ir andando? = Can I walk there?
• ¿Cuántos kilómetros hay? = How many kilometers are there?
• ¿Hay mucho tráfico? = Is there a lot of traffic?

📌 EXAMPLES:
• Está a cinco minutos a pie.
• Está muy cerca de aquí.
• ¿Cuánto se tarda en coche?
ejemplos: Está a cinco minutos a pie.

dict.如果你过了桥，就走过了。在桥之前。: If you cross the bridge, you've gone too far. Before the bridge.

dict.玛丽亚在马约尔广场。她想去博物馆。她问一位先生：: María is in Plaza Mayor. She wants to go to the museum. She asks a gentleman:
dict.打扰一下，博物馆在哪里？: Excuse me, where is the museum?
dict.博物馆很近。沿着这条街直走，然后在第二条街右转。然后在这个红绿灯过马路。博物馆在: The museum is very close. Go straight along this street, then turn right at the second street. Then cross the street at this traffic light. The museum is on the corner, at the end of the street.
dict.不客气。旅途愉快！: You're welcome. Have a good trip!
dict.文中开头说玛丽亚在马约尔广场。: The text says at the beginning that María is in Plaza Mayor.
dict.她应该在哪个街口转弯？: At which street corner should she turn?
dict.先生告诉她走第二条街右转。: The gentleman tells her to turn right at the second street.
dict.文中说博物馆在拐角，在街的尽头。: The text says the museum is on the corner, at the end of the street.
dict.步行需要多长时间？: How long does it take on foot?
dict.文中说步行五分钟。: The text says a five-minute walk.
dict.在西班牙的许多城市都有一个马约尔广场（主广场）。这是一个中心且非常重要的地方。那: In many Spanish cities there is a Plaza Mayor (main square). It is a central and very important place. There are shops, cafes, and restaurants. Madrid's Plaza Mayor is famous and has a Christmas market. In Salamanca, the Plaza Mayor is the heart of the city. People gather there to chat, stroll, or have coffee. Plaza Mayor is a reference point when asking for directions.
dict.在中国，人们也经常用广场作为参照点，比如天安门广场。但西班牙的马约尔广场通常被建: In China, people also often use squares as reference points, like Tiananmen Square. But Spanish Plaza Mayor is usually surrounded by buildings, while Chinese squares tend to be more open.
dict.是阳性名词，用 al（a + el），不用 a la。: It is a masculine noun, use al (a + el), not a la.
dict.这个句子本身正确，但要注意 ser/estar：描述位置用 estar。常见错误: This sentence is correct, but note ser/estar: use estar to describe location. A common mistake is using es a la derecha.
dict.这个句子正确。常见错误是发不清 r 和 l，比如把 gira 发成 gila。: This sentence is correct. A common mistake is not pronouncing r and l clearly, like saying gila for gira.
dict.问位置时用 estar，不用 ser。: Use estar, not ser, when asking about location.
dict.这个句子正确。注意 cerca de 是固定搭配，不要说 cerca a。: This sentence is correct. Note that cerca de is a fixed phrase, don't say cerca a.
dict.打扰一下，车站在哪里？: Excuse me, where is the station?

dict.走第二条街左转。: Take the second street and turn left.
dict.在人行横道过马路。: Cross the street at the crosswalk.
dict.西班牙语的 r（尤其是词尾的 r）和 l 是不同的音。发 r 时舌尖轻弹上齿龈，: The Spanish r (especially at the end of a word) and l are different sounds. For r, tap the tip of your tongue lightly against the alveolar ridge; for l, press the tip of your tongue against the alveolar ridge and let air flow out from the sides. Chinese students often confuse them, for example pronouncing derecha as delecha.
dict.去博物馆，沿着这条街直走。: To the museum, go straight along this street.
dict.是固定表达，意为“直走”。: It is a fixed expression meaning 'go straight'.
dict.博物馆在街的尽头。: The museum is at the end of the street.
dict.是固定短语，但这里用 en el final 也可以，不过更常见的是 al fi: It is a fixed phrase, but here en el final is also possible, though al final is more common. But en el is acceptable in the options. Note: the correct form is al final de la calle. But according to the options, en el is suitable because final is a masculine noun.
dict.表示时间距离用 a + 时间。: Use a + time to express time distance.
dict.走第二条街右转。: Take the second street and turn right.

dict.在红绿灯过马路。: Cross the street at the traffic light.
dict.过马路通常在红绿灯处。: Crossing the street is usually at the traffic light.
dict.教堂在街的拐角。: The church is on the corner of the street.

dict.是环岛，也是一种广场。: It is a roundabout, also a kind of square.

dict.李伟在教堂拐角做什么？: What does Li Wei do at the church corner?
dict.街道尽头有什么？: What is at the end of the street?
dict.直走，过马路，左转：你就快到了！: Go straight, cross the street, turn left: you're almost there!
